styleguide.title: Design system
styleguide.subtitle: Every component in the MG Holding portal, in both languages, both themes and both densities. The company accent is switchable, because no screen may depend on a particular one.
styleguide.worldText: Every record in this portal is a labelled specimen: an identity, its measured values with units, and a provenance line saying who last touched it. The cards that hold those records are soft, rounded sheets on warm off-white paper, read in deep pine ink. A ticket, a room, a colleague and an announcement are all read the same way, so one reading habit covers the whole product.

notes.colour: Warm off-white paper, deep pine ink and one fixed lime highlight. The company accent arrives at runtime from the Company record and every brand value below is derived from it, with AA guaranteed for any hue.
notes.type: IBM Plex Sans and IBM Plex Sans Arabic, self-hosted, two weights. Large headings are set in the regular weight; the bold is kept for small things that must be found fast. Digits always come from the Latin face, so numerals line up identically in both languages.
notes.space: One 4px pitch. The 1px hairline is the only sub-pitch value and the portal's only structural separator.
notes.labelstrip: The signature. It always carries the record's real fields, never decorative labels. Hover or focus a card to see the strip register.
notes.tables: Below 640px every row becomes a label card and each cell takes its column name as a micro-label. Resize the window to see it.
notes.elevation: Elevation is declared once per element: a hairline or a shadow, never both. Cards take the hairline however soft their corner; only dialogs, toasts and popovers float.
notes.motion: One authored moment, on the label strip. Everything else is a plain state change, the arrow button’s two-pixel lean included. All of it stops under reduced motion.
notes.dates: Native pickers, restyled. Stored in UTC, shown in Cairo time. The working week runs Sunday to Thursday.
notes.arabic: Arabic is designed for, not mirrored. It gets its own leading and measure, and never takes uppercase or letter-spacing: the micro-label's small-caps treatment is replaced by weight and colour rather than applied and broken.
notes.radii: Soft outside, measured inside. A card takes 16px and the welcome banner 24px; a control takes 10px. Compact density brings back 10px frames and 6px controls for tables and work pages.
notes.density: Two densities from one set of tokens. Home and reading pages are comfortable. Work pages, tables and record lists carry data-density="compact", which tightens corners, control height and cell padding. On a phone the 44px tap target always wins.
notes.tags: A tag names the kind of thing a card holds; a badge states a status. Lime marks what opens something or what is new. It always carries deep pine on top and is never used as text.
notes.records: Soft card outside, ruled specimen inside. Each row opens with a compact label strip of the record’s real fields. Hover or focus a row to see its strip register.
